identity: IXI followed by its exact three-digit source identifier; all modalities, visits, labels and known derivative aliases inherit one role
population: Union of original T1 and MRA source IDs from the complete authenticated TAR metadata inventory; retain missing-modality cases in their role and denominator
strata: source site code in original filenames
annotation ID present in publisher label preview
stratum_ambiguity: A person with multiple site codes stays grouped; use a distinct unresolved or multi-site stratum, do not invent a site or remove the person to improve counts
stratum_counts: Hamilton largest remainder: floor(n * percentage / 100), distribute remaining people by descending integer remainder; ties use role_order
ranking: Ascending SHA256 of UTF-8(namespace + exact IXI identifier), then exact identifier; allocate contiguous ranks in role_order within each stratum
role_preservation: Preserve every existing assignment and alias restriction; do not rerank a frozen cohort after QC failure, missing modality, future source addition or source correction
payload_role_boundary: Root may authorize opaque mixed-role source archive staging. No member extraction, NIfTI header read, image array, annotation value or outcome access follows from byte intake. Later readers must enforce each role and declared input/private-reference fields.
held_out_claim: Internal person holdout only. No established unseen-pretrained, external-site or clinical evaluation claim; SynthStrip evaluation includes the IXI family and exact released-checkpoint exposure remains unresolved.

evidence_types.T1: Genuinely acquired structural image; prospective limited input after intended-use QC
evidence_types.MRA: Genuinely acquired same-person vascular measurement; private reference, not automatically an actor channel
evidence_types.vessel_mask: Derived SynthStrip/Frangi/manual-edited reference with reported surgeon review and incomplete sensitivity/coverage; distinct from acquired MRA

prohibitions: No unlabelled voxel interpreted as proven vessel-free
No vessel-mask intersection interpreted as clinical injury
For any held-out scored case, private MRA or annotation cannot affect actor features, action generation, action legality, stopping or nominal prediction before that strategy is frozen
TRAIN may support separately authorized privileged learning; this permission never makes private held-out anatomy available at deployment
SELECT may support declared method/checkpoint selection after frozen candidate scoring; no optimizer updates or population preprocessing fitted on SELECT
MEASUREMENT_EVAL cannot support calibration, method/hyperparameter selection, optimizer updates or population preprocessing fitting
No change to other collections' protected roles
